summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $408.2M and $144.6M accumulations in SPX 6000C (exp 2026). While SPY shows a bearish P/C of 1.37, the massive premium in SPX and SPXW calls suggests institutions are using deep-out-of-the-money LEAPS to hedge or bet on long-term index expansion. Persistent interest is clearly visible in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-05-15) and 7150C (exp 2026-06-18) positions, which have seen billions in accumulation over the last 4 sessions. Traders should watch for volatility around the SPX 7150 level and monitor if the aggressive call buying in AMZN, INTC, and NVDA (all with extremely low P/C ratios) triggers a momentum breakout in tech.
